stories.title: Hurricane Polo a very powerful Category 4 storm off Mexico's Pacific coast

en.title: Hurricane Polo a very powerful Category 4 storm off Mexico's Pacific coast
en.summary: Hurricane Polo rapidly intensified to Category 5 strength before weakening to Category 4 off southwestern Mexico's Pacific coast.

stories.title: Redrawn Missouri congressional map lands before Supreme Court for third time

en.title: Redrawn Missouri congressional map lands before Supreme Court for third time
en.summary: Missouri's congressional map dispute returned to the U.S. Supreme Court for a third time after an appeals court revived districts supported by President Trump.

stories.title: Defending Trump media ban, DOJ cites national security and says White House access is a ‘privilege’

en.title: Defending Trump media ban, DOJ cites national security and says White House access is a 'privilege'
en.summary: The Department of Justice argued that President Trump has the authority to bar CNN, MSNOW, and Politico from White House access, characterizing such access as a discretionary privilege based on national security grounds.

stories.title: DOJ defends White House media ban, urges court to reject lawsuit

en.title: DOJ defends White House media ban, urges court to reject lawsuit
en.summary: The Department of Justice defended President Trump's ban of CNN, MS Now, and Politico from the White House, asserting their reporting on various issues compromised national security and disseminated false information.

stories.title: Poll: Trust in the U.S. Postal Service delivering mail-in ballots on time has fallen

en.title: Poll: Trust in the U.S. Postal Service delivering mail-in ballots on time has fallen
en.summary: Registered voters have decreased confidence that the U.S. Postal Service will deliver election mail promptly compared to 2024, following the service's involvement in efforts to restrict mail voting.

stories.title: Trump says his ballroom will house a drone port. The Secret Service already has one.

en.title: Trump says his ballroom will house a drone port. The Secret Service already has one.
en.summary: President Trump announced plans to install a rooftop drone port in his new White House ballroom for defensive purposes, despite the Secret Service already operating such a facility.

stories.title: Iran's president in N.Y. as Trump weighs cutting deal or driving Iran "into hell"

en.title: Iran's president in N.Y. as Trump weighs cutting deal or driving Iran "into hell"
en.summary: President Trump indicated at the United Nations that he is considering whether to negotiate with Iran or pursue confrontational measures, as Iran's president prepares to address the world body.

stories.title: Category 5 Hurricane Polo is 'one of the strongest storms ever'

en.title: Category 5 Hurricane Polo is 'one of the strongest storms ever'
en.summary: Hurricane Polo has intensified into one of the most powerful Pacific cyclones in recent decades and was projected to pass Mexico's southwestern coast as a Category 5 hurricane.

en.title: CNN, MS NOW and Politico sue to restore White House access
en.summary: Three news organizations banned from White House grounds by President Trump are pursuing legal action on constitutional grounds to restore their access.

stories.title: White House Defends Trump’s Ban on CNN, MS NOW and Politico in Court Filing

en.title: White House Defends Trump's Ban on CNN, MS NOW and Politico in Court Filing
en.summary: The White House defended President Trump's decision to ban CNN, MS NOW, and Politico from White House access, citing alleged violations of professional and decorum standards.

stories.title: DOJ charges Utah postal worker for allegedly dumping mail ballots in trash

en.title: DOJ charges Utah postal worker for allegedly dumping mail ballots in trash
en.summary: A U.S. Postal Service worker in Utah was charged by the Justice Department for discarding over 300 mail ballots intended for voters in the state's June primary election.

stories.title: Postal worker threw out 300 mail-in ballots out of self-described ‘laziness,’ DOJ says

en.title: Postal worker threw out 300 mail-in ballots out of self-described 'laziness,' DOJ says
en.summary: A postal worker discarded 300 mail-in ballots, according to DOJ charges attributing the action to the worker's own admission of laziness.

stories.title: Zelensky Says Putin Is Unlikely to Curb Attacks Without U.S. Pressure

en.title: Zelensky Says Putin Is Unlikely to Curb Attacks Without U.S. Pressure
en.summary: Ukrainian President Zelensky stated that Russian President Putin is unlikely to reduce military attacks unless the United States applies diplomatic pressure.

stories.title: Swiss Parliament’s Upper House Backs Plan to Ease New Capital Demands on UBS

en.title: Swiss Parliament's Upper House Backs Plan to Ease New Capital Demands on UBS
en.summary: Switzerland's upper parliamentary chamber approved a proposal to reduce capital requirements for UBS, lowering the mandatory top-tier capital ratio for foreign subsidiaries to 90% from a previously planned 100%.

en.title: Gadgets Are Going Premium—and Manufacturers Are Raking It In
en.summary: Device manufacturers are shifting toward higher-priced products sold in lower volumes, a trend reshaping the gadget industry landscape.

en.title: Oil Prices Mixed as Traders Weigh U.S.-Iran Talks, Saudi Pipeline Progress
en.summary: Oil price movements reflected investor assessment of diplomatic discussions between U.S. and Iranian officials and Saudi Arabia's testing of its East-West pipeline infrastructure.

stories.title: Stock Futures Nudge Higher as Markets Weigh Middle East Diplomacy

en.title: Stock Futures Nudge Higher as Markets Weigh Middle East Diplomacy
en.summary: U.S. stock futures and oil prices moved slightly higher while Treasury yields remained relatively flat as investors evaluated potential diplomatic developments in the Middle East.
